summation.displayName: PLCgamma (PLCG) is recruited to FCGR and the phosphorylated ...
summation.text: PLCgamma (PLCG) is recruited to FCGR and the phosphorylated Y342 and Y346 in SYK have been reported to be involved in the interaction of PLCG (Law et al. 1996). PLCG accumulates at the phagocytic cup during FCGR, but the exact role of PLCG in the regulation of phagocytosis is not clear. It may be involved in FCGR signaling by activating PKC through DAG production (Garcia-Garcia & Rosales 2002 )
